raw.buffDescription: The Attacker gains an indefinite +500 [k=glossary/cruelty]Cruelty[/k] Buff for every 10 hits in their Combo Meter. If their Combo Meter is set to 0 when struck, all Cruelty Buffs are removed, each dealing 40% of the Defender's Attack as a burst of Direct Damage.
